scenes.line: Mee-ra! Thee-oh! Hop in — we're flying past all eight planets! First, Mercury: the smallest planet, and the closest to the Sun. Ooh, toasty!
scenes.action: She waves, hops into a chubby little white rocket with red fins with the unicorn tucked under her arm, and zooms past a tiny grey cratered planet right beside a huge blazing Sun; the unicorn fans itself with a wing.
scenes.sfx: rocket whoosh as they launch, deep crackling roar of the Sun

scenes.line: Next, Venus: the hottest planet of all, wrapped in thick yellow clouds. Phew! And there's Earth: our home, with blue oceans, green trees... and you!
scenes.action: The little rocket flies through swirling hot yellow clouds and the unicorn's mane frizzes up; then they burst out beside a beautiful blue and green Earth, and she points down at it and waves.
scenes.sfx: sizzling hiss of hot clouds, then a gentle whoosh

scenes.line: Mars is the red planet, covered in rusty red dust. Achoo! And Jupiter is the biggest of all, with a storm so huge it could swallow our whole Earth!
scenes.action: They zoom low over a dusty red planet and a puff of red dust makes the unicorn sneeze; then a gigantic striped planet with a huge swirling red storm fills the whole sky, and her eyes go wide.
scenes.sfx: dusty wind, a tiny unicorn sneeze, deep rumbling storm

scenes.line: Saturn has beautiful rings, made of ice and rock. And Saturn is so light, it could float in a giant bathtub! Look, she's surfing the rings!
scenes.action: The rocket glides past a golden planet with glittering icy rings; the unicorn leaps out and surfs along the rings on a chunk of ice, and she laughs and claps.
scenes.sfx: tinkling ice chimes, a playful swoosh as the unicorn surfs

scenes.line: Uranus spins on its side, so it rolls around the Sun like a ball! And Neptune, the farthest planet, is deep blue and super windy. Hold on tight!
scenes.action: They pass a pale blue-green planet tipped on its side, rolling along; then a deep blue planet where a howling wind blows her hair and the unicorn's mane wildly as she clings on, laughing.
scenes.sfx: soft rolling rumble, then howling whistling wind

scenes.line: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune. Eight planets! Now, home for tea. See you soon, Mee-ra! See you soon, Thee-oh!
scenes.action: The little rocket turns and flies back towards a glowing blue Earth; she waves goodbye to the viewer, and the sleepy unicorn yawns and curls up on her shoulder.
scenes.sfx: gentle rocket whoosh, soft sparkling chime at the end
